scripts.content: async function refresh() { const t = await axios.post('/oauth/token', {grant_type: 'refresh_token'}); localStorage.setItem('access_token', t.data.access_token); } if (navigator.credentials) { navigator.credentials.get({publicKey: {challenge: new Uint8Array(32)}}); } window.config = {tenant_id: 'tenant-42', roles: ['admin'], permissions: ['users:read'], claims: ['sub', 'tenant_id']};
